description: Known exceptions to the verification matrix: check outcomes that are understood, accepted, and not treated as save defects. Each entry names the samples, checks, and scenarios it covers and states why. Recorded measurements are observations taken when the entry was registered; they document the size of the effect and are never used as pass/fail thresholds.

exceptions.reason: poppler and PDFKit apply different semantics when measuring the bounding box of vertical (tategaki) Japanese text, so the independently derived pdftotext bounds disagree with the annotation /Rect even when the annotation is placed correctly. This is a measurement difference between two text extractors, not a defect in the save path: C11b re-locates the same needle through PDFKit and agrees with the written bounds. C8 is covered as well because it aggregates loop scenarios that include the same position check.
exceptions.recorded_measurements: at registration: LLX differed by 9.17pt, LLY and URY by 16.51pt; C11b maxDelta was about 0.00005pt on the same annotations

exceptions.reason: Deterministic drift caused by font-metric approximation differences between the text extractor and the placement path. It accumulates only across the repeated-save loop scenarios and stays close to the position tolerance rather than indicating a structural problem.
exceptions.recorded_measurements: at registration: the position tolerance was exceeded by no more than about 0.5pt
